The fish looks large and healthy by my standards, but the person who caught it remarked that it was relatively small. What is the fish community composition of this lake? The surrounding terrestrial plant life has a dense understory with many shrubs and grasses with interspersed tall standing trees that I observe to be mostly coihue common.
